scenarios.title: 1. Setup inline hint visible only when apiReady is false
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the setup inline hint with the message 'Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.' is shown only when apiReady is false and not when true.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.

scenarios.title: 2. Run button disabled when API is not ready
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the 'Analyze change' run button is disabled when apiReady is not true despite URL and diff input conditions.

scenarios.title: 3. Index and Generate Playwright plan buttons disabled initially
scenarios.purpose: Check that 'Index repository context' and 'Generate Playwright plan' buttons are disabled when pipeline is not configured (apiReady is false).

scenarios.title: 5. Load example diff button inserts sample diff containing 'Invoice not found' text
scenarios.purpose: Verify that clicking the 'Load example diff' button populates the unified diff textarea with sample text containing the string 'Invoice not found'.
